虚拟语气:与过去事实相反: 谈"当时没发生"的假设:从句 had + 过去分词,主句 would have + 过去分词。
与过去相反:If + had done,主句 would/could/might have done|主句常见错误:would had done ❌|省略 if:Had you asked, ...|注意与"现在相反"区分:看时间状语|事后诸葛式的遗憾、道歉、复盘常用此结构
If we had booked earlier, we would have got better seats.
column3: 要是我们早点订票,座位会好得多。

虚拟语气:与过去事实相反: If the alarm had rung, I wouldn't have missed the train.
column3: 要是闹钟响了,我就不会误火车。

虚拟语气:与过去事实相反: She could have won if she had entered the senior group.
column3: 她要是报了成年组,本来是有机会赢的。

虚拟语气:与过去事实相反: Had they listened to the pilot study, the launch would not have flopped.
column3: 要是他们听取试点研究的意见,发布就不会翻车。

虚拟语气:与过去事实相反: I would have called you, but my phone died.
column3: 我本想给你打电话,可手机没电了。

# title: If you ___ me, I would have helped immediately.
column4: 与过去相反,从句用 had asked。

# title: If the map had been accurate, we ___ lost.
虚拟语气:与过去事实相反: wouldn't get|hadn't got|wouldn't have got|won't get
column4: 主句用 would not have got。

# title: ___ she known the truth, she would have stayed.
column4: 省略 if 的倒装:Had she known...

# title: He would have joined us if his flight ___ delayed.
column4: 与过去相反,从句用 hadn't been。

# title: I ___ the deadline if you hadn't reminded me.
column4: 与过去相反,主句用 would have missed。

虚拟语气:与过去事实相反: If the team had practised more, they would have won.|If the team practised more, they would have won.|If the team had practised more, they would win.|If the team would have practised more, they had won.
column4: 与过去相反:had practised + would have won。
